moments.name: Legacy Monolithic Order Desk Baseline
moments.description: Captures the initial TraderX equities desk where traderx-web posts orders over plain HTTP directly into monolith-order-svc backed by oracle-trades-db without gateway isolation or transport encryption.

commit-messages: feat(arch): capture initial TraderX legacy order desk baseline

moments.name: Zero-Trust API Gateway & OIDC Enforcement
moments.description: Introduces edge-api-gateway and ping-oidc-idp per ADR-001, severing direct browser-to-monolith access, enforcing PKCE token introspection, and mandating the mtls-everywhere control on internal hops.

commit-messages: feat(security): introduce edge API gateway and OIDC identity provider
refactor(ingress): route traderx-web traffic exclusively through edge-api-gateway
feat(auth): wire OIDC PKCE and JWKS validation links
feat(controls): upgrade east-west gateway hop to mTLS and enforce mtls-everywhere

moments.name: Order Router Extraction & Kafka Backbone
moments.description: Extracts stateless order-router-svc ahead of kafka-event-bus per ADR-002 and defines order-submission-flow so ingress order capture decouples cleanly from downstream trade booking.

commit-messages: feat(messaging): provision Kafka order event backbone
feat(routing): extract stateless order-router-svc behind API gateway
feat(routing): stream router events through kafka-event-bus into monolith consumer
feat(flows): codify order-submission-flow across ingress pipeline

moments.name: Pre-Trade Risk Circuit Breaker & Cache
moments.description: Deploys pretrade-risk-svc backed by redis-position-cache per ADR-003, gating order-router-svc over synchronous gRPC/mTLS credit and fat-finger checks before orders reach kafka-event-bus.

commit-messages: feat(risk): add SEC 15c3-5 pretrade-risk-svc node
feat(risk): back pretrade-risk-svc with redis-position-cache
feat(risk): wire synchronous gRPC/mTLS pre-trade risk gate from order-router-svc
feat(flows): insert pre-trade risk verification steps into order-submission-flow

moments.name: FIX Venue Execution & Live Market Data
moments.description: Adds fix-execution-gateway connected to external-liquidity-venue over FIX-4.4/TLS alongside market-data-feed and execution-fill-flow for real-time mark-to-market exposure and drop-copy fills.

commit-messages: feat(execution): introduce fix-execution-gateway and external-liquidity-venue
feat(execution): connect Kafka approved order topic through FIX gateway to venue
feat(marketdata): wire live NBBO market-data-feed into risk and position cache
feat(execution): publish venue ExecutionReports to Kafka and add execution-fill-flow
feat(execution): expose dedicated fix-dropcopy-session interface on FIX gateway

moments.name: Legacy Monolith Retirement & Clearing Split
moments.description: Migrates trade persistence and clearing to trade-ledger-svc, settlement-clearing-svc, and postgres-trades-db over TLS, permanently decommissioning monolith-order-svc and oracle-trades-db.

commit-messages: feat(ledger): deploy trade-ledger-svc and postgres-trades-db alongside legacy monolith
feat(ledger): wire Kafka fill consumer through trade-ledger-svc to PostgreSQL
feat(clearing): add T+1 settlement-clearing-svc backed by PostgreSQL trade store
refactor(decommission): retire legacy monolith-order-svc and oracle-trades-db

moments.name: SEC 17a-4 Immutable WORM Audit Archive
moments.description: Streams Kafka execution events through worm-audit-archiver into s3-object-lock-vault per ADR-004, binding the sec-17a4-worm retention control and exposing audit verification to compliance-officer.

commit-messages: feat(compliance): introduce worm-audit-archiver and s3-object-lock-vault
feat(compliance): stream Kafka lifecycle events into WORM Object-Lock vault
feat(controls): bind sec-17a4-worm 7-year compliance retention control
feat(compliance): model compliance-officer supervisory access to worm-audit-archiver

moments.name: DORA Multi-Region Failover & Telemetry
moments.description: Adds dr-standby-cluster replication and otel-observability-hub distributed tracing per ADR-005, codifying operational failover readiness under the dora-ict-resilience control.

commit-messages: feat(resilience): add otel-observability-hub and dr-standby-cluster
feat(resilience): enable cross-region WAL and Kafka replication to dr-standby-cluster
feat(observability): stream OTLP telemetry from router, risk, and FIX gateway
feat(controls): add dora-ict-resilience control for multi-region failover readiness

moments.name: FINRA CAT T+1 Regulatory Reporting Pipeline
moments.description: Launches cat-regulatory-reporter reconciled against s3-object-lock-vault and trade-ledger-svc to transmit SFTP/mTLS reports to finra-cat-portal under regulatory-cat-submission-flow and finra-cat-sla.

commit-messages: feat(cat): introduce cat-regulatory-reporter and external finra-cat-portal
feat(cat): reconcile cat-regulatory-reporter against WORM vault and trade ledger
feat(cat): wire SFTP/mTLS submission channel to finra-cat-portal
feat(flows): define regulatory-cat-submission-flow across WORM, ledger, and FINRA CAT
feat(controls): enforce finra-cat-sla T+1 08:00 ET reporting control
